title: The Domestic task in the house
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：domestic　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 domestic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the researcher wrote of ① a domestic task in the house in the paper, and everybody in the lab said at once that it was ② more domestic than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the researcher, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the domestic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most domestic task in the house anybody in the lab had ever seen, or so the paper for February 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too domestic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the domestic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a domestic market for the wool, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as domestic as the market for the wool they had once had in the old lab. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was domestic or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was ⑦ something domestic, and nothing besides. The student from the next lab called the whole plan ⑧ quite domestic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the paper kept the names of the domestic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, for the whole place, she wrote of another domestic task in the house in the same paper, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ more domestic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most domestic market for the wool in the whole lab, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the domestic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 家务（前置定语 a domestic task in the house：1964 年研究员在研究报告里记下的那件家务的活计）
B. adj. 家务／国内（比较级 more domestic than：文中两处，一处比屋里的活计，一处比预想）
C. adj. 家务／国内（最高级 the most domestic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 家务（表语 too domestic to do：母亲觉得它太家务，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 国内（前置定语 a domestic market for the wool：叔叔把整件事称作一桩国内的市场）
F. adj. 国内（同级比较 as domestic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩羊毛的国内市场相比）
G. adj. 国内（后置定语 something domestic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 国内（受程度副词修饰 quite domestic：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a domestic task in the house
the most domestic task in the house anybody
a domestic market for the wool
The most domestic market for the wool in

answers.why: domestic 意为“家务”，1964 年研究员在研究报告里记下的是“一件家务的活计”，此处作前置定语 a domestic task in the house。
domestic 意为“家务”，此处用比较级 more domestic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
domestic 意为“家务”，研究报告上 二月 那行字说它是实验室里最家务的一件，故用最高级 the most domestic task in the house。
domestic 意为“家务”，母亲认为这件东西“太家务了，谁也用不上”，too domestic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
domestic 意为“国内”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩国内的市场”，此处作前置定语 a domestic market for the wool。
domestic 意为“国内”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩羊毛的国内市场一样国内”，同级比较用 as domestic as。
domestic 意为“国内”，研究报告上那半行字要的是“国内的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something domestic。
domestic 意为“国内”，邻实验室来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当国内”，quite 修饰原级 domestic。
domestic 意为“国内”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要国内”，故用比较级 more domestic than。
domestic 意为“国内”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个实验室里最国内的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most domestic market for the wool。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，研究员在研究报告里记下了一件家务的活计。（a domestic task in the house）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更家务。（more domestic than …）
母亲觉得它太家务，谁也用不上。（too domestic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩国内的市场。（a domestic market for the wool）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩羊毛的国内市场一样国内。（as domestic as …）
到了 1971 年，研究报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件国内的东西。（something domestic）
answers: In 1964 the researcher wrote of a domestic task in the house in the paper.
Everybody said it was more domestic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too domestic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a domestic market for the wool.
He said nobody would call it as domestic as the market for the wool they had once had.
By 1971 the paper asked for nothing but something domestic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 domestic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the researcher wrote of a domestic task in the house in the paper, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most domestic task in the house in the lab, or so the paper says.
My mother thought it too domestic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a domestic market for the wool, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next lab called the plan quite domestic, and everybody laughed.
The domestic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
